open_points.subject: A8 semantic validation ownership
open_points.text:
the refusal of a missing required setting or of a value of the
  wrong form.
open_points.question: Does `runtime_settings` own rejection of every value the A8 start-up table disallows, including an out-of-range integer port, an unknown time-zone name, and a value outside `RuntimeEnvironment`, or only failures of lexical parsing; if only lexical parsing, which module owns those semantic checks?
options: Reject every value that violates the A8 table in `runtime_settings`.
Reject only values that cannot be parsed into the declared type, leaving range, time-zone-database, and enumeration membership checks to another unspecified module.
open_points.default_guess: Treat every A8 table constraint as validation owned by `runtime_settings`.

witness.initial: `PORTAL_DELIVERER_PORT` is set to `0`; all required settings are present and otherwise valid.
events: The process starts and `runtime_settings` reads the environment.
A careful implementer parses `0` as a whole number and must decide whether being outside 1–65535 is a wrong form.
outcomes: Start-up ends because the port violates the A8 accepted range.
The settings object is returned with port 0 because the value has the right integer form.

open_points.subject: required string settings
open_points.text:
a value of the
  wrong form.
open_points.question: What constitutes a wrong-form value for the required `str` path settings `binary_root`, `state_dir`, `connections_file`, and `credential_file`, given that path existence is explicitly outside this module and A8 supplies no lexical path grammar?
options: Every present environment string is form-valid; using modules check only existence and usability.
Reject empty strings or other path spellings according to an unstated lexical path policy.
Perform additional path validation short of checking existence.
open_points.default_guess: Accept every present string here and leave path existence and usability to the consuming modules.

witness.initial: All required variables are present, but `PORTAL_DELIVERER_STATE_DIR` is the empty string.
events: The process starts and `runtime_settings` reads the environment.
The implementation interprets the ownership of refusal for a value of the wrong form.
outcomes: Start-up ends because an empty path string is treated as having the wrong form.
A settings object containing an empty `state_dir` is returned because the value is present and is a string.

open_points.subject: meaning of a missing required setting
open_points.question: Is a required setting missing only when its environment variable is absent, as A8 states, or also when the variable is present with an empty value?
options: Only an absent environment variable is missing.
An absent or empty environment variable is missing.
open_points.default_guess: Treat only absence as missing; handle an empty value, if invalid at all, under an explicitly defined value-validation rule.

witness.initial: `PORTAL_DELIVERER_BINARY_ROOT` exists in the process environment with value ``; every other setting is valid.
events: The process starts and `runtime_settings` tests whether required settings are missing.
outcomes: The setting is present, so start-up continues with an empty `binary_root`.
The empty value is treated as missing, so start-up ends.
